from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil
root=Path('/Users/brunobuger/orca/workspaces/put-checks/ui-studio')
prep=root/'docs/qa/evidence/STUDIO-OBS-011/recovery-20261020/runner-deadline-diagnostic'
plan=json.loads((prep/'derivative-copy-plan.json').read_text()); binding=json.loads((prep/'bindings.json').read_text())
h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
src=Path(plan['sourceRtRepo']); dest=Path(plan['derivativeRepo']); derivative=Path(plan['derivativeRoot'])
assert not derivative.exists() and not derivative.is_symlink()
assert h(prep/'instrumentation.patch')==binding['patchSha256']
snapshot=root/binding['sourceSnapshotPath']; assert h(snapshot)==binding['sourceSnapshotSha256']
rows=json.loads(snapshot.read_text())['trees']['repo']['sourceFiles']
for row in rows: assert h(src/row['path'])==row['sha256']
for row in binding['threeTargets']: assert h(prep/'instrumented'/row['path'])==row['instrumentedSha256']
initial=[{'path':p.relative_to(src/'studio-runner/dist').as_posix(),'sha256':h(p)} for p in sorted((src/'studio-runner/dist').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
assert initial==binding['baseRtDistManifest']
derivative.mkdir(); dest.mkdir()
for rel in plan['copies']:
    a=src/rel; b=dest/rel; b.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if a.is_dir(): shutil.copytree(a,b,symlinks=False,ignore=lambda directory,names: [n for n in names if n in plan['optionalTopLevelStudioRunnerExclusions']] if Path(directory)==src/'studio-runner' else [])
    else: shutil.copy2(a,b,follow_symlinks=True)
for rel in plan['emptyDirectories']: (dest/rel).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(src/'studio-runner/dist',derivative/'pristine-dist',symlinks=False)
for row in binding['threeTargets']: shutil.copy2(prep/'instrumented'/row['path'],dest/row['path'])
expected={row['path']:row['instrumentedSha256'] for row in binding['threeTargets']}
for row in rows: assert h(dest/row['path'])==expected.get(row['path'],row['sha256'])
for row in initial: assert h(dest/'studio-runner/dist'/row['path'])==row['sha256'] and h(derivative/'pristine-dist'/row['path'])==row['sha256']
assert h(dest/'studio-runner/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs')=='39db22f579acf5639bbb17a261408debbde03f4692c0c439e77e7f13aeba74d6'
assert h(dest/'studio-runner/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc')=='8d5fa5bd883fec0979fc2004f1fe1d99aef40570155d550eadc0b03b55513bf0'
receipt={'diagnosticOnly':True,'baseSelectedSourceDigest':binding['baseSelectedSourceDigest'],'instrumentedSelectedSourceDigest':binding['expectedInstrumentedSelectedSourceDigest'],'initialDistDigest':binding['baseRtDistDigest'],'patchSha256':binding['patchSha256'],'targets':binding['threeTargets'],'noEvidencePayloadCopied':True,'noTestExecuted':True}
(derivative/'seed-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'derivative':str(derivative),'seedReceipt':str(derivative/'seed-receipt.json'),'initialDistDigest':binding['baseRtDistDigest']}))
